title: Sharp Flag-Channel Spectra, Dyadic Rational Witnesses, Analytic Even-n Bound Magic, Depolarizing Magic-Breaking, and the Anticommuting-Triple Outer Spectrahedron
abstract: Kitzinger, Eisert, and Kunjwal (2026, arXiv:2611.34872v1) proved that multi-qubit bound magic exists under the full set of stabilizer-preserving operations by combining odd-n PPT-bound-entangled Pauli states with an odd-n Pauli flag channel F_n, while leaving open exact flag-channel spectra, rational odd-n witnesses, analytic even-n constructions, tight depolarizing magic-breaking thresholds, and outer relaxation barriers. We establish four exact, self-contained structural theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) Exact Flag-Channel Cardinality Correction, Full Eigenvalue Spectrum, & Dyadic Rational Odd-n Witnesses: we correct the cardinality of the odd-n flag set from 2^(n-1)(2^(n-1)-1) to (2^n-1)(2^(n-1)-1), derive the exact eigenvalue spectrum of F_n across all Pauli orbits, and construct an explicit dyadic-rational odd-n bound-magic witness family in B_3(Q) \ STAB_3; (2) Analytic Even-n Bound Magic via Two-Orbit Pauli Channels G_n: extending beyond odd n, we construct a two-orbit Pauli flag channel G_n for every even n >= 4 with exact closed-form eigenvalues across all orbits, prove 1-uniformity, and certify analytic even-n bound magic; (3) Sharp Depolarizing Magic-Breaking Thresholds & Conjecture 4 Convex Span: we derive exact upper and lower bounds on the depolarizing magic-breaking threshold via qubit 2-design algebra and l1-simplex ceilings, resolving Conjecture 4 on the full depolarizing family; and (4) Symplectic Anticommuting-Triple Outer Spectrahedron O_n & Distillation Ceilings: we characterize the tensor-stable, Clifford-covariant convex outer spectrahedron O_n >= B_n (O_1 = STAB_1), establish the CHSH ceiling on B_n, and derive quantitative fidelity ceilings for arbitrary stabilizer-preserving operations.
